companies_identification_uq.name: companies_identification_uq
companies_identification_uq.where: "companies"."identification_type" is not null and "companies"."identification_number" is not null

instagram_attempts_operation_key_check.name: instagram_attempts_operation_key_check
instagram_attempts_operation_key_check.value: "instagram_attempts"."operation_key" = sha256(convert_to(case when kind = 'resolve' then 'R' when kind = 'profile' then 'P' || profile_pk when request_cursor is null then 'N' else 'S' || request_cursor end, 'UTF8'))

instagram_run_followers_enriched_attempt.name: instagram_run_followers_enriched_attempt_check
instagram_run_followers_enriched_attempt.value: ("instagram_run_followers"."enrichment" in ('done', 'not_found') and "instagram_run_followers"."enriched_attempt_no" is not null) or ("instagram_run_followers"."enrichment" = 'pending' and "instagram_run_followers"."enriched_attempt_no" is null) or "instagram_run_followers"."enrichment" = 'private'

instagram_runs_target_check.name: instagram_runs_target_check
instagram_runs_target_check.value: ("instagram_runs"."target_pk" is null and "instagram_runs"."target_username" is null and "instagram_runs"."target_follower_count" is null and "instagram_runs"."target_is_private" is null and "instagram_runs"."target_is_verified" is null) or ("instagram_runs"."target_pk" is not null and "instagram_runs"."target_username" is not null and "instagram_runs"."target_is_private" is not null and "instagram_runs"."target_is_verified" is not null)
